nodes.label: Engine DJ two-way sync
nodes.rationale: With Source.sync on the main Engine DJ library, GLUE Home merges each song's hot cues, saved loops and grid three ways, writes when Engine DJ is closed after backup, and takes Engine DJ's changes into GLUE. Playlists stay in DJ collection, edited from there; GLUE's playlists in Engine DJ's GLUE folder both ways.

nodes.label: DJ libraries: import, detect and follow
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home detects DJ libraries in folders, reads them as imports, and follows every collection's libraries by date every 5s. Engine reads rekordbox XML, Traktor NML, Apple Music XML, Serato, Engine DJ's m.db and M3U. Import brings metadata first, then music folders linked.

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON files for collections and playlists
nodes.rationale: The GLUE folder stores all user data as JSON files, no database. Structure: mco.json (index and profiles), profiles/<pid>/profile.json (collections), profiles/<pid>/collections/<cid>/collection.json (metadata), tracks, analysis, lists (one per playlist), sources (imported DJ libraries), events.json, dupes (duplicates per computer), backups (daily zips).

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri tray app with Rust engine
nodes.rationale: When GLUE Home runs, it is the library's engine and the website on that computer is its screen. Tauri 2 on Windows/macOS. Provides local link on 127.0.0.1:47400-47409 with /hello, /connect, /fs routes. Engine in Rust does library work: sync, analysis, DJ library reading/following, cue/loop/grid sync with Engine DJ.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: optional account, collections sync, signaling
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object. Holds account's collections (never music), profiles and devices. Collections synced per account; signaling for WebRTC connections between devices.
